text:
Riley (People Ops): putting together a 1-paragraph cheat sheet managers can paste into check-ins or review forms: one-line outcome headline + micro-evidence + one next step. aim for copy/paste readiness. drop examples or a quick anti-pattern.

Jordan: cool. my format: HEADLINE — METRIC (WHEN)
Example: "Reduced model p99 by 25% this quarter."
Evidence: "Ramp deployed + verified on staging; p99 shown in /metrics."
Next step: "Schedule a 30m runbook session to hand off to oncall."

Leah: product example: "Increased activation rate by 8% in 30 days."
Evidence: "A/B test, cohort analysis in Mixpanel; variant B won."
Next step: "Add the winning flow to the onboarding backlog and assign owner."

Omar: hiring ops example (pasteable):
Headline: "Cut time-to-offer for SWE ICs from 26 to 14 days this quarter."
Evidence: "Introduced scorecards + 48h interviewer scheduling window; data in Greenhouse reports."
Next step: "Document new scheduler workflow and run a 1-week pilot for new roles."

HR Bot: DM template to collect quick pre-review notes:
```
Hey <name> — before our 1:1 could you paste a 1-line headline, one evidence sentence, and one blocker if any? Example:
- Headline: Improved embedding latency by 12% this month.
- Evidence: bench + prod metrics.
- Blocker: need time to finalize quantization docs.
Thanks!
```

Jordan: manager micro-phrases to paste into feedback:
- "Clear measurable outcome; love the ownership."
- "Can you list the dependency and owner so we can unblock?"

Leah: anti-patterns to avoid:
- Vague verbs without a metric ("improved system").
- Long timelines or logs instead of outcome + evidence.

Omar: self-review starters (IC copy/paste):
- "Headline: I reduced infra cost by X% by doing Y."
- "Evidence: linked PR + metrics dashboard."
- "Next step: train two teammates and add playbook."

Riley (People Ops): awesome 1 saving these into a one-pager. i'll post the pastepack in the handbook and share a short slack snippet for DMs. if anyone has a concise policy/benefits example, toss it here.

Leah: benefits example:
Headline: "Increased employee participation in health plan wellness program by 40% in 6 months."
Evidence: "New incentives + clearer comms; reports in HRIS."
Next step: "Expand incentive to remote employees and track uptake."

Riley (People Ops): perfect, thanks all — will publish later today :sparkles:
